table_assessment.assessment_notes: The isolated table contains 25 assertion-bearing recommendation rows covering sleep evaluation, long-term monitoring, pacing, CRT, device programming, and post-MI pacing. All assertions are normative non-medication instructions; source-native Class and Level values are retained row by row.

header_path: Sleep evaluation

normative_assertions.notes: Screening is recommended for the stated SAS symptoms or sleep-associated severe bradycardia/advanced AV block.

text_units.verbatim_text: Screening for SAS is recommended in patients with symptoms of SAS and in the presence of severe bradycardia or advanced AVB during sleep.

entities.surface_form: patients with infrequent (less than once a month) unexplained syncope or other symptoms suspected to be caused by bradycardia
a comprehensive evaluation did not demonstrate a cause

header_path: Recommendation for implantable loop recorder

normative_assertions.notes: Long-term ambulatory ILR monitoring is conditional on infrequent unexplained symptoms after unrevealing comprehensive evaluation.

text_units.verbatim_text: In patients with infrequent (less than once a month) unexplained syncope or other symptoms suspected to be caused by bradycardia in whom a comprehensive evaluation did not demonstrate a cause, long-term ambulatory monitoring with an ILR is recommended.

entities.surface_form: patients with SND and a DDD pacemaker
minimization of unnecessary ventricular pacing through programming

header_path: Cardiac pacing for bradycardia and conduction system disease

normative_assertions.notes: Programming should minimize unnecessary ventricular pacing in patients with SND and a DDD pacemaker.

text_units.verbatim_text: In patients with SND and a DDD pacemaker, minimization of unnecessary ventricular pacing through programming is recommended.

header_path: Cardiac pacing for bradycardia and conduction system disease

normative_assertions.notes: Pacing is indicated when symptoms are clearly attributable to bradyarrhythmias in SND.

text_units.verbatim_text: Pacing is indicated in SND when symptoms can clearly be attributed to bradyarrhythmias.

entities.surface_form: symptomatic patients with the bradycardia–tachycardia form of SND

header_path: Cardiac pacing for bradycardia and conduction system disease

normative_assertions.notes: Pacing is indicated to correct bradyarrhythmias and enable pharmacological treatment unless ablation is preferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Pacing is indicated in symptomatic patients with the bradycardia–tachycardia form of SND to correct bradyarrhythmias and enable pharmacological treatment, unless ablation of the tachyarrhythmia is preferred.

entities.surface_form: patients with bradyarrhythmias related to SND which are asymptomatic or due to transient causes that can be corrected and prevented

header_path: Cardiac pacing for bradycardia and conduction system disease

normative_assertions.notes: Pacing is recommended against for asymptomatic SND-related bradyarrhythmias or correctable transient causes.

text_units.verbatim_text: Pacing is not recommended in patients with bradyarrhythmias related to SND which are asymptomatic or due to transient causes that can be corrected and prevented.

entities.surface_form: patients in SR with permanent or paroxysmal third- or second-degree type 2, infranodal 2:1, or high-degree AVB

header_path: Cardiac pacing for bradycardia and conduction system disease

normative_assertions.notes: Pacing is indicated for the specified AV block patterns irrespective of symptoms.

text_units.verbatim_text: Pacing is indicated in patients in SR with permanent or paroxysmal third- or second-degree type 2, infranodal 2:1, or high-degree AVB, irrespective of symptoms. e

entities.surface_form: patients with atrial arrhythmia (mainly AF) and permanent or paroxysmal third- or high-degree AVB

header_path: Cardiac pacing for bradycardia and conduction system disease

normative_assertions.notes: Pacing is indicated for atrial arrhythmia with the specified AV block patterns irrespective of symptoms.

text_units.verbatim_text: Pacing is indicated in patients with atrial arrhythmia (mainly AF) and permanent or paroxysmal third- or high-degree AVB, irrespective of symptoms.

entities.surface_form: patients with permanent AF in need of a pacemaker
ventricular pacing with rate response function

header_path: Cardiac pacing for bradycardia and conduction system disease

normative_assertions.notes: Rate-responsive ventricular pacing is recommended for patients with permanent AF requiring a pacemaker.

text_units.verbatim_text: In patients with permanent AF in need of a pacemaker, ventricular pacing with rate response function is recommended.

entities.surface_form: patients with AVB due to transient causes that can be corrected and prevented

header_path: Cardiac pacing for bradycardia and conduction system disease

normative_assertions.notes: Pacing is recommended against for AV block caused by correctable and preventable transient causes.

text_units.verbatim_text: Pacing is not recommended in patients with AVB due to transient causes that can be corrected and prevented.

entities.surface_form: patients with unexplained syncope and bifascicular block
second- or third-degree intra- or infra-Hisian block during incremental atrial pacing

header_path: Cardiac pacing for bradycardia and conduction system disease

normative_assertions.notes: Pacemaker therapy is indicated when at least one of the specified electrophysiological findings is present.

text_units.verbatim_text: In patients with unexplained syncope and bifascicular block, a pacemaker is indicated in the presence of either a baseline HV interval of ≥70 ms, second- or third-degree intra- or infra-Hisian block during incremental atrial pacing, or abnormal response to pharmacological challenge.

entities.surface_form: patients with alternating BBB with or without symptoms

header_path: Cardiac pacing for bradycardia and conduction system disease

normative_assertions.notes: Pacing is indicated for alternating bundle branch block regardless of symptom status.

text_units.verbatim_text: Pacing is indicated in patients with alternating BBB with or without symptoms.

header_path: Cardiac pacing for bradycardia and conduction system disease

normative_assertions.notes: Pacing is recommended against for asymptomatic BBB or bifascicular block.

text_units.verbatim_text: Pacing is not recommended for asymptomatic BBB or bifascicular block.

entities.surface_form: patients aged >40 years, with severe, unpredictable, recurrent syncope
spontaneous documented symptomatic asystolic pause(s) >3 s

header_path: Recommendations for pacing for reflex syncope

normative_assertions.notes: Dual-chamber pacing is indicated for patients over 40 with severe recurrent syncope and any listed cardioinhibitory/asystolic criterion.

text_units.verbatim_text: Dual-chamber cardiac pacing is indicated to reduce recurrent syncope in patients aged >40 years, with severe, unpredictable, recurrent syncope who have: spontaneous documented symptomatic asystolic pause(s) >3 s or asymptomatic pause(s) >6 s due to sinus arrest or AVB; or cardioinhibitory carotid sinus syndrome; or asystolic syncope during tilt testing.

entities.surface_form: absence of a documented cardioinhibitory reflex

header_path: Recommendations for pacing for reflex syncope

normative_assertions.notes: Cardiac pacing is recommended against when no documented cardioinhibitory reflex is present.

text_units.verbatim_text: Cardiac pacing is not indicated in the absence of a documented cardioinhibitory reflex.

header_path: Recommendations for pacing for reflex syncope

normative_assertions.notes: Pacing is recommended against for unexplained falls without another documented indication.
source_trigger_texts: in the absence of any other documented indication

text_units.verbatim_text: Pacing is not recommended in patients with unexplained falls in the absence of any other documented indication.

header_path: Recommendations for pacing for reflex syncope

normative_assertions.notes: Pacing is recommended against for unexplained syncope without evidence of SND or conduction disturbance.
source_trigger_texts: without evidence of SND or conduction disturbance

text_units.verbatim_text: Pacing is not recommended in patients with unexplained syncope without evidence of SND or conduction disturbance.

entities.surface_form: symptomatic patients with HF in SR with LVEF ≤35% , QRS duration ≥150 ms, and LBBB QRS morphology despite OMT

header_path: CRT

normative_assertions.notes: CRT is recommended for the stated HF phenotype and electrical criteria to improve symptoms and reduce morbidity and mortality.

text_units.verbatim_text: CRT is recommended for symptomatic patients with HF in SR with LVEF ≤35% , QRS duration ≥150 ms, and LBBB QRS morphology despite OMT, to improve symptoms and reduce morbidity and mortality.

entities.surface_form: patients with HF and a QRS duration <130 ms without indication for RV pacing

header_path: CRT

normative_assertions.notes: CRT is recommended against when QRS is under 130 ms and no RV-pacing indication exists.

text_units.verbatim_text: CRT is not indicated in patients with HF and a QRS duration <130 ms without indication for RV pacing.

entities.surface_form: patients with symptomatic AF and an uncontrolled heart rate who are candidates for AVJ ablation (irrespective of QRS duration)

header_path: CRT

normative_assertions.notes: CRT is recommended for HFrEF patients with symptomatic AF and uncontrolled rate who are AVJ-ablation candidates.

text_units.verbatim_text: In patients with symptomatic AF and an uncontrolled heart rate who are candidates for AVJ ablation (irrespective of QRS duration), CRT is recommended in patients with HFrEF.

entities.surface_form: patients with HFrEF ( <40% ) regardless of NYHA class who have an indication for ventricular pacing and high-degree AVB

header_path: CRT

normative_assertions.notes: CRT is positively recommended over RV pacing for the stated HFrEF/AV-block population, including AF.
The comparative wording recommends against choosing RV pacing when CRT is the recommended alternative in this population.

text_units.verbatim_text: CRT rather than RV pacing is recommended for patients with HFrEF ( <40% ) regardless of NYHA class who have an indication for ventricular pacing and high-degree AVB in order to reduce morbidity. This includes patients with AF.

entities.surface_form: patients who are candidates for an ICD, and who have CRT indication

header_path: CRT

normative_assertions.notes: CRT-D implantation is recommended for ICD candidates who also have a CRT indication.

text_units.verbatim_text: In patients who are candidates for an ICD, and who have CRT indication, implantation of a CRT-D is recommended.

entities.surface_form: patients treated with His bundle pacing
device programming tailored to specific requirements of His bundle pacing

header_path: Recommendations for using His bundle pacing

normative_assertions.notes: Device programming should be tailored to His bundle pacing requirements.

text_units.verbatim_text: In patients treated with His bundle pacing, device programming tailored to specific requirements of His bundle pacing is recommended.

entities.surface_form: waiting period of at least 5 days

header_path: Pacing in acute myocardial infarction

normative_assertions.notes: Permanent pacemaker implantation is indicated when AV block persists for at least five days after MI.

text_units.verbatim_text: Implantation of a permanent pacemaker is indicated with the same recommendations as in a general population ( section 5.2 ) when AVB does not resolve within a waiting period of at least 5 days after MI.

header_path: Pacing in acute myocardial infarction

normative_assertions.notes: Pacing is recommended against when AV block resolves after revascularization or spontaneously.

text_units.verbatim_text: Pacing is not recommended if AVB resolves after revascularization or spontaneously.
